_comment: Fishing. The catch_* lines are the Legendary and Mythic sea creatures' catch messages, quoted from each creature's page on the wiki (2026-10-16); mythic_* marks the Mythic ones. The sea creature names are the wiki's Sea Creatures list. The cap message is quoted on the wiki. The double hook, trophy fish and bobber formats aren't quoted there; they follow what other mods match and are on the test list.
catch_Water Hydra: The Water Hydra has come to test your strength\.
catch_Alligator: A long snout breaks the surface of the water\. It's an Alligator!
catch_Titanoboa: A massive Titanoboa surfaces\. Its body stretches as far as the eye can see\.
catch_Puddle Jumper: A Puddle Jumper is preparing for liftoff—cast your rod into it and hold on tight!
catch_Frog Prince: Bow down before the Frog Prince\.\.\. or pay the hefty price!
catch_The Loch Emperor: The Loch Emperor arises from the depths\.
catch_Nessie: You've caused a disturbance in the loch\. Could it be\.\.\. Nessie\?
catch_Silkbreeze: Something zips through the air - it's a Silkbreeze!
catch_Giant Isopod: A Giant Isopod was dredged up from the depths!
catch_Reindrake: A Reindrake forms from the depths\.
catch_Phantom Fisher: The spirit of a long lost Phantom Fisher has come to haunt you\.
catch_Grim Reaper: This can't be! The manifestation of death himself!
catch_Great White Shark: Hide no longer, a Great White Shark has tracked your scent and thirsts for your blood!
catch_Blue Ringed Octopus: A garish set of tentacles arise\. It's a Blue Ringed Octopus!
catch_Wiki Tiki: The water bubbles and froths\. A massive form emerges- you have disturbed the Wiki Tiki! You shall pay the price\.
catch_Thunder: You hear a massive rumble as Thunder emerges\.
catch_Lord Jawbus: You have angered a legendary creature\.\.\. Lord Jawbus has arrived\.
catch_Fiery Scuttler: A Fiery Scuttler inconspicuously waddles up to you, friends in tow\.
catch_Ragnarok: The sky darkens and the air thickens\. The end times are upon us: Ragnarok is here\.
catch_Abyssal Miner: An Abyssal Miner breaks out of the water!
